en: Colorized panoramic view of a small industrial town in a rural valley. A winding river runs through green fields and meadows, with numerous red‑brick factory buildings and tall smokestacks scattered along its banks. Around the factories are clusters of detached houses and larger villas with steep, dark roofs and light facades. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall spire. Low wooded hills and patchwork farmland surround the settlement under a lightly clouded sky. The image looks like an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard; there is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
